Asks api.github.com once a day for the latest Delos release and offers it here. GitHub sees this device’s IP address; nothing else is sent. Off: no request at all.
Asks GitHub now. A new version is offered on the start screen.
Version %1$s has no download for this device

Once a day, when Delos starts, it asks api.github.com for the newest release. GitHub sees this device’s IP address; nothing else is sent. If a newer version exists, the start screen offers it with its release notes. Only when you press Update does Delos download it from GitHub and check its SHA-256 against the list published with the release; Android then asks you before it installs, and refuses an update signed with another key. Off: no request at all. Not tested on a device yet.
Asks GitHub now, even if it asked less than a day ago. A newer version is offered on the start screen. Needs Check for updates to be on.
